text: Carpentry builds structures and furniture through specific methods and tool application. Solid assemblies rely heavily on connection points like the 榫 (xuàn) joint to bind wood segments firmly. These fasteners enable seamless joins between parts while resisting warping and distortion as time passes. Protecting the final item frequently requires varnish, which also improves visual appeal. The finishing process applies a thin coat of this substance or paint to level uneven surfaces and establish a tough barrier against the elements.
